question: Select the most appropriate option the fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**piece**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes Mr. Cyril Boggis as a talented salesman, and when buying or selling, he deals with items, specifically antique furniture.
 
• The appropriate word for blank 5 is "**piece**" **(****टुकड़ा****)** because it refers to an individual item, in this case, an antique piece of furniture.
 
• Other options like "pace", "pose", and "peace" do not fit the context of selling individual items, especially antiques, which are typically referred to as "pieces".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Apart from the fact that he was at this moment, disguised as a spiritual leader in the Christian Church, there was nothing sinister about Mr. Cyril Boggis. He was by trade a dealer in antique furniture, with his own shop and showroom in the King’s Road, Chelsea. His premises were not large, and generally he did not do a great deal of business, but because he always bought very, very cheap and sold very, very dear he managed to make quite a tidy little income every year. He was a talented salesman, and when buying or selling a piece__ he could slide smoothly into whichever mood suited the client best. He was well aware of his gift using it shamelessly on every possible occasion.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Pace" (गति)** refers to speed or rate, which does not fit in the context of describing an item being sold.
 
• **"Pose" (मुद्रा) **refers to a position or posture, which does not match the context of dealing with items like furniture.
 
• **"Peace" (शांति)** refers to tranquility or calm, which is unrelated to selling items like antiques.
